titleEn: Rainy Neon Noodle Stall Selfie Live Boil-Over
titleZh: 雨夜街头拉面摊自拍直播煮沸翻车
subjectEn: a photorealistic late-night ramen chef in a black apron with a collar wireless lavalier mic holding an 18mm ultra-wide front-facing smartphone gimbal at arm's length behind a steaming street noodle counter
subjectZh: 系黑色围裙、领口夹无线领夹麦的写实深夜拉面摊主，在热气腾腾的街头面摊后右臂前伸一臂距离持握18mm超广角手机前置云台自拍

shots.role: Hook / 开播暴击点名弹幕
shots.actionEn: lifts the wooden pot lid with the left hand releasing a puff of aromatic steam while grinning directly into the 0° held selfie lens
shots.actionZh: 左手掀开木质汤锅盖冒出一团白雾香气，0°怼脸直视手持前置镜头向夜猫子观众打招呼
shots.eyeLineEn: direct 0° front-camera eye-contact with a quick 8° downward glance at phone chat
shots.eyeLineZh: 0°直视前置镜头互动，顺势向下8°扫一眼屏幕弹幕
shots.cameraEn: 18mm ultra-wide arm's-length selfie framing with warm lantern bokeh
shots.cameraZh: 18mm一臂超广角前置自拍构图，带暖黄灯笼散景
shots.sfx: 掀锅盖蒸汽声 + 雨夜街头环境声
shots.caption: 凌晨两点的神仙豚骨汤，直播间云吃夜宵！

shots.role: Proof / 托底微距展示溏心蛋
shots.actionEn: holds chopsticks lifting a glossy soft-boiled egg 20cm from the lens with flat palm behind it so continuous autofocus locks onto the golden yolk
shots.actionZh: 筷子夹起流心溏心蛋递至距镜头20厘米处并以手掌平摊托底，触发手机连续微距自动对焦锁死金黄蛋黄
shots.eyeLineEn: checks 0° autofocus sharpness around the held chopsticks
shots.eyeLineZh: 在溏心蛋与0°前置对焦框之间确认清晰度
shots.cameraEn: 18mm handheld selfie cam with smooth foreground macro focus pull
shots.cameraZh: 手持前置机位平滑拉近微距焦点
shots.sfx: 高汤咕嘟沸腾声 + 对焦轻响
shots.caption: 看这流心质感，手掌托底零滤镜！

shots.role: Twist / 忙看弹幕汤锅扑锅溢泡沫
shots.actionEn: while leaning in reading chat comments, the broth pot behind suddenly foams over with a loud hiss, startling the chef into a quick pivot
shots.actionZh: 正凑近手机屏幕念感谢榜一弹幕时，身后汤锅突然咕嘟沸腾漫出白沫滋滋作响，吓得摊主猛地扭头救火
shots.eyeLineEn: 8° phone-screen read snapping backward toward the boiling pot in panic
shots.eyeLineZh: 从8°低头念弹幕瞬间惊恐扭头看向身后沸锅
shots.cameraEn: 18mm selfie frame jolting with sudden startled turn
shots.cameraZh: 18mm前置画面随转身救锅产生真实急促晃动
shots.sfx: 汤水扑锅滋啦大响 + 惊呼收音
shots.caption: 卧槽光顾着谢礼物汤扑锅了！！

shots.role: Payoff / 关火抹汗无语盯镜头
shots.actionEn: turns off the burner knob with a sigh of relief and wipes forehead while staring deadpan into the 0° selfie lens as chat laughs
shots.actionZh: 拧灭炉火长舒一口气，抬手抹了一把额头汗水，对着0°前置摄像头满屏哈哈弹幕露出无奈苦笑
shots.eyeLineEn: 8° glance at laughing danmaku locking into 0° wry smile
shots.eyeLineZh: 扫一眼刷屏嘲笑弹幕后定格0°无奈苦笑
shots.cameraEn: Stabilized 18mm selfie close-up matching opening stall framing
shots.cameraZh: 恢复平稳的18mm面摊自拍构图回扣开场
shots.sfx: 旋钮咔哒关火声 + 礼物连击叮声
shots.caption: 刷『糊锅仙人』的明天来摊位不加肉！
